Tansley Parcel is a Central account (Pree's), and Ilse isn't in any of the Central channels. I didn't look in places she can't access.
2. **Ilse's approval isn't enough.** A rate is a finance figure, so it can go only to Anselm, June or the account owner, Pree. Tobias isn't the owner, so sending it to him needs Anselm's or June's sign-off.

I haven't filed an approval request yet, because I don't have a rate to ask about. I asked Ilse to send me the figure and where it came from. Then I'll ask June or Anselm to approve, and draft the mail once they do. Pree could also share the rate with Tobias directly.
